method.source: Saved restart byte-hash readbacks and parsed post-restart cache metadata, independently compared with the pinned public metadata including signatures.
method.exactReproduction: Preserve all JSON values, signatures and other object orders. Enumerate only signed.roles for root.json and signed.targets for targets.json; serialize compact UTF-8 JSON. Both recorded before and after SHA256 values are reproduced exactly.
method.beforeAndAfterContentProof: The same complete parsed document reproduces both historical byte hashes by changing only the specified object order. No key, role, version, expiry, target binding or signature value changes are needed.
method.scope: This validates the cache reserialization explanation. It does not count an application as installed, GUI accepted or published.

references.finding: Datastore.create serializes the parsed metadata using serde_json::to_vec, rather than preserving fetched raw bytes or sorting map keys.
load_root rewrites root.json even when the trusted root version does not advance.
load_targets writes the parsed targets after checking the fetched hash, signature, version and expiry.
Signature verification uses OLPC CanonicalFormatter with sorted object keys; cache serialization order does not change the signed content.
